title: 3dkmeans
description: 3d+t Clustering segmentation based on The C clustering library.

input.description: Input data to be clustered. You can specify multiple filenames in sequence and they will be concatenated internally.
input.title: Input data files

mask.description: Dataset to be used as a mask; only voxels with nonzero values in 'mset' will be used.
mask.title: Mask dataset

mask_range.description: Restrict the voxels from 'mset' to only those mask values between 'a' and 'b' (inclusive).
mask_range.title: Mask range

cmask.description: Execute the options enclosed in single quotes as a 3dcalc-like program to produce a mask from the resulting 3D brick.
cmask.title: Custom mask options

jobname.description: Specify a different name for the output files. Default is derived from the input file name.
jobname.title: Output job name

prefix.description: Specify a prefix for the output volumes. Default is the same as jobname.
prefix.title: Output prefix

distance_measure.description: Specifies distance measure for clustering. Supported values: 0 (No clustering), 1 (Uncentered correlation distance), 2 (Pearson distance), 3 (Uncentered correlation distance, absolute value), 4 (Pearson distance, absolute value), 5 (Spearman's rank distance), 6 (Kendall's distance), 7 (Euclidean distance), 8 (City-block distance).
distance_measure.title: Distance measure for clustering

remap_method.description: Reassign clusters numbers based on METHOD: NONE (default), COUNT, iCOUNT, MAG, iMAG.
remap_method.title: Remap method

clabels.description: Provide a label for each cluster. Labels cannot start with '-'.
clabels.title: Cluster labels

clust_init.description: Specify a dataset to initialize clustering. If provided, sets -r 0.
clust_init.title: Cluster initialization dataset

num_repeats.description: Number of times the k-means clustering algorithm is run.
num_repeats.title: Number of k-means runs

rsigs.description: Calculate distances from each voxel's signature to the signatures in this multi-column file. No clustering done.
rsigs.title: Signatures file

write_dists.description: Output text files containing various distance measures.
write_dists.title: Write distances

voxdbg.description: Output debugging info for specified voxel (I J K).
voxdbg.title: Voxel debugging

seed.description: Seed for the random number generator. Default is 1234567.
seed.title: Random seed
